name: Centaur Bounty
summary: In Desolace, Felgur Twocuts calls for blood after Khan Dez'hepah. He wants fifteen ears from centaur of any clan.

sections.title: Time to Bleed Them
sections.body: Felgur Twocuts says the centaur clans have been scared. Now, he says, it is time to bleed them. As you travel across Desolace, hunt centaur from any clan and gather fifteen ears. Felgur wants to thin their numbers and weaken their resolve. He means to end any thoughts of expansion.

sections.title: Felgur's Verdict
sections.body: When you return, Felgur says the centaur must know your name by now. He believes they respect and fear you. They know the banner you ride under as well: the Horde's.

faq.q: Who orders this bounty on the centaur?
faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts orders the bounty in Desolace. He wants fifteen centaur ears brought back to him.

faq.q: Which centaur clans need to be hunted?
faq.answer: You can hunt centaur from any clan. Felgur asks only that you gather ears.

faq.q: Why does Felgur want so many centaur ears?
faq.answer: Felgur wants to weaken the centaur numbers. He believes fewer centaur will weaken their resolve and end any thoughts of expansion.
The bounty follows Khan Dez'hepah. Felgur says the centaur clans have been scared, and now it is time to bleed them.
